## Manipulation Checks

```{r}
manip_balance_table <- df |> 
  select(Treatment = exp_condition,
         "Anxiety-Hope" = anxiety_hope_dim,
         "Anxiety Rating" = exp_check_anxious,
         "Angry Rating" = exp_check_angry,
         "Hopeful Rating" = exp_check_hopeful,
         "Happy Rating" = exp_check_happy,
         "Calm Rating" = exp_check_calm,
         "Comment Sentiment" = exp_comment_sentiment) |> 
  mutate(Treatment = factor(Treatment, levels = c("anxiety", "hope", "control"), 
                            labels = c("Anxiety", "Hope", "Control"))) |> 
  datasummary_balance(~Treatment, 
                      data = _,
                      fmt = 2)

manip_balance_table |> 
  save_tt(here(table_dir, "manipulation_balance.docx"), overwrite = TRUE)

manip_balance_table
```

```{r}
#| fig-height: 5
#| fig-width: 8
manip_check_data <- df |>
  select(id, exp_condition, starts_with("exp_check")) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("exp_check"),
    names_to = "emotion",
    values_to = "rating",
    names_prefix = "exp_check_"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    emotion = factor(emotion, 
                     levels = c("angry", "anxious", "hopeful", "happy", "calm"), 
                     labels = c("Angry", "Anxious", "Hopeful", "Happy", "Calm"))
  )

# Define emotion colors for the manipulation check boxplot
manip_check_colors <- c(
  "Angry" = "#e07a7a",
  "Anxious" = "#f4a582",
  "Hopeful" = "#a8ddb5",
  "Happy" = "#ffd97d",
  "Calm" = "#7eb3d4"
)

manip_check_data |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = exp_condition, y = rating, fill = emotion)) +
  geom_boxplot(
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.9),
    width = 0.6,
    outlier.size = 0.8,
    outlier.alpha = 0.3
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = manip_check_colors,
    name = "Emotion"
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(
    labels = c("anxiety" = "Anxiety", "hope" = "Hope", "control" = "Control")
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(-10, 110),
    breaks = seq(0, 100, 20),
    expand = c(0.05, 0.05)
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Experimental Condition",
    y = "Emotion Rating (0-100)",
    subtitle = "Thinking back to the Instagram post that you saw earlier, 
to what extent did the post make you feel …"
  ) +
  theme_allround() +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(override.aes = list(shape = NA)))

ggsave(here(figure_dir, "manipulation_check.svg"), width = 8, height = 5, web_fonts = svg_fonts)
```

```{r}
manip_pairwise <- manip_check_data |>
  group_by(emotion) |>
  pairwise_t_test(
    rating ~ exp_condition,
    detailed = TRUE,
    pool.sd = FALSE,
    p.adjust.method = "holm",
    ref.group = "control"
  ) |>
  ungroup()

manip_pairwise_table <- manip_pairwise |>
  select(Emotion = emotion, 
         `Group 1` = group1, 
         `Group 2` = group2, 
         `Mean 1` = estimate1,
         `Mean 2` = estimate2, 
         `Estimate` = estimate,
         p, p.adj,
         df) |>
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), \(x) round(x, 3))) |> 
  tt()

manip_pairwise_table

manip_pairwise_table |> 
  save_tt(here(table_dir, "manipulation_pairwise.docx"), overwrite = TRUE)
```

```{r}
# Helper function to create correlogram
scatter_function_grouped <- function(data, mapping, ...) {
  ggplot(data = data, mapping = mapping) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.2, size = 1) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", 
                se = TRUE, 
                linewidth = 1.2, 
                alpha = 0.5, 
                na.rm = TRUE)
}
```

## Exploratory Manipulation Check Models

```{r}
# brms settings
bayes_seed <- 42
chains <- 4
iter <- 4000
warmup <- floor(iter/2)
adapt_delta <- 0.90
max_treedepth <- 10

# marginaleffects settings
options(marginaleffects_posterior_interval = "hdi")
options(marginaleffects_posterior_center = stats::median)
```

```{r}
df_mod <- df |> 
  mutate(across(c(exp_share, exp_like), as.numeric)) |> 
  mutate(exp_share_pomp = (exp_share - 1) / 4,
         exp_like_pomp = (exp_like - 1) / 4,
         comment_sentiment_pomp = (exp_comment_sentiment - 1) / 6,
         Anxious = exp_check_anxious / 100,
         Angry = exp_check_angry / 100,
         Hopeful = exp_check_hopeful / 100,
         Happy = exp_check_happy / 100,
         Calm = exp_check_calm / 100)
```

```{r}
priors <- c(
  prior(normal(0.5, 0.5), class = "Intercept"),
  prior(normal(0, 0.5), class = "b"),
  prior(exponential(4), class = "sigma"))
```

### Anxiety-Hope Dimension

```{r}
#| output: false
ah1 <- brm(
  data = df_mod,
  family = gaussian(),
  formula = anxiety_hope_dim ~ exp_condition,
  prior = priors,
  sample_prior = "yes",
  init = "random",
  chains = chains,
  iter = iter,
  warmup = warmup,
  seed = bayes_seed,
  control = list(
    adapt_delta = adapt_delta,
    max_treedepth = max_treedepth),
  file = here(model_dir, "ah1.rds")
  )
```

### Emotion Ratings

```{r}
# Create formula with set_rescor
f_er1 <- bf(mvbind(Anxious, Angry, Hopeful, Happy, Calm) ~ exp_condition) + 
  set_rescor(FALSE)

# Specify priors for each response variable
priors_er <- c(
  prior(normal(0.5, 0.5), class = "Intercept", resp = "Anxious"),
  prior(normal(0.5, 0.5), class = "Intercept", resp = "Angry"),
  prior(normal(0.5, 0.5), class = "Intercept", resp = "Hopeful"),
  prior(normal(0.5, 0.5), class = "Intercept", resp = "Happy"),
  prior(normal(0.5, 0.5), class = "Intercept", resp = "Calm"),
  prior(normal(0, 0.5), class = "b", resp = "Anxious"),
  prior(normal(0, 0.5), class = "b", resp = "Angry"),
  prior(normal(0, 0.5), class = "b", resp = "Hopeful"),
  prior(normal(0, 0.5), class = "b", resp = "Happy"),
  prior(normal(0, 0.5), class = "b", resp = "Calm"),
  prior(exponential(4), class = "sigma", resp = "Anxious"),
  prior(exponential(4), class = "sigma", resp = "Angry"),
  prior(exponential(4), class = "sigma", resp = "Hopeful"),
  prior(exponential(4), class = "sigma", resp = "Happy"),
  prior(exponential(4), class = "sigma", resp = "Calm")
)
```

```{r}
#| output: false
er1 <- brm(
  data = df_mod,
  family = gaussian(),

  prior = priors_er,

  init = "random",
  chains = chains,
  iter = iter,
  warmup = warmup,
  seed = bayes_seed,
  control = list(
    adapt_delta = adapt_delta,
    max_treedepth = max_treedepth
  )
)
```


## Visualise

### Part 1

```{r}
# Prepare predictions for all models
models_list <- list(
  ah1 = ah1,
  sent1 = sent1,
  share1 = share1,
  like1 = like1
)

outcome_labels <- c(
  ah1 = "Anxiety-Hope Dimension",
  sent1 = "Comment Sentiment",
  share1 = "Likelihood to Share",
  like1 = "Likelihood to Like"
)

predictions <- map_dfr(names(models_list), function(model_name) {
  expand_grid(
    exp_condition = c("control", "anxiety", "hope")
  ) |>
    add_epred_draws(models_list[[model_name]], re_formula = NA) |>
    ungroup() |>
    mutate(
      outcome = model_name,
      outcome_label = outcome_labels[model_name],
      .epred = .epred * 100  # Convert to percentage points
    )
})

# Calculate pairwise contrasts and check if they exclude zero
contrasts <- predictions |>
  select(outcome, outcome_label, exp_condition, .draw, .epred) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = exp_condition, values_from = .epred) |>
  mutate(
    anxiety_vs_control = anxiety - control,
    hope_vs_control = hope - control,
    anxiety_vs_hope = anxiety - hope
  )

contrast_summary <- contrasts |>
  group_by(outcome, outcome_label) |>
  summarise(
    across(
      c(anxiety_vs_control, hope_vs_control, anxiety_vs_hope),
      list(
        lower = ~hdi(.x, .width = 0.95)[[1]],
        upper = ~hdi(.x, .width = 0.95)[[2]]
      ),
      .names = "{.col}_{.fn}"
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    anxiety_diff_control = sign(anxiety_vs_control_lower) == sign(anxiety_vs_control_upper),
    hope_diff_control = sign(hope_vs_control_lower) == sign(hope_vs_control_upper),
    anxiety_diff_hope = sign(anxiety_vs_hope_lower) == sign(anxiety_vs_hope_upper)
  )

# Generate compact letter display
cld_labels <- contrast_summary |>
  mutate(
    control_label = case_when(
      # Intransitivity: control bridges anxiety and hope
      !anxiety_diff_control & !hope_diff_control & anxiety_diff_hope ~ "ab",
      TRUE ~ "a"
    ),
    anxiety_label = case_when(
      # Anxiety bridges control and hope
      !anxiety_diff_control & hope_diff_control & !anxiety_diff_hope ~ "ab",
      # Anxiety same as control
      !anxiety_diff_control & !anxiety_diff_hope              ~ "a",
      !anxiety_diff_control & anxiety_diff_hope               ~ "a",
      # Anxiety differs from control
      anxiety_diff_control  & !anxiety_diff_hope              ~ "b",
      anxiety_diff_control  & anxiety_diff_hope               ~ "b"
    ),
    hope_label = case_when(
      # Hope bridges control and anxiety
      !hope_diff_control & !anxiety_diff_hope & anxiety_diff_control  ~ "ab",
      # Intransitivity: hope=b (control bridges)
      !hope_diff_control & anxiety_diff_hope  & !anxiety_diff_control ~ "b",
      # All same
      !hope_diff_control & !anxiety_diff_hope & !anxiety_diff_control ~ "a",
      # Hope~control, anxiety differs from both
      !hope_diff_control & anxiety_diff_hope  & anxiety_diff_control  ~ "a",
      # Hope differs from control
      hope_diff_control  & !anxiety_diff_hope                         ~ "b",
      hope_diff_control  & anxiety_diff_hope  ~ if_else(anxiety_diff_control, "c", "b")
    )
  ) |>
  select(outcome, outcome_label, control_label, anxiety_label, hope_label) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(control_label, anxiety_label, hope_label),
    names_to = "condition",
    values_to = "cld"
  ) |>
  mutate(exp_condition = str_remove(condition, "_label")) |>
  select(outcome, outcome_label, exp_condition, cld)

# Combine plotting data with CLD labels
plot_data <- predictions |>
  left_join(cld_labels, by = c("outcome", "outcome_label", "exp_condition"))

# Check the CLD labels
cld_labels |> 
  pivot_wider(names_from = exp_condition, values_from = cld) |>
  arrange(outcome)
```

```{r}
part1 <- plot_data |>
  mutate(
    outcome_label = factor(
      outcome_label,
      levels = c("Anxiety-Hope Dimension", "Comment Sentiment", 
                 "Likelihood to Share", "Likelihood to Like")
    ),
    exp_condition = factor(
      exp_condition,
      levels = c("hope", "anxiety", "control"),
      labels = c("Hope", "Anxiety", "Control")
    )
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = .epred, y = exp_condition, fill = exp_condition)) +
  stat_halfeye(
    .width = c(0.95, 0.66),
    point_interval = "median_qi",
    alpha = 0.8,
    height = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = plot_data |>
      mutate(

        )

  ) +
```

### Part 2

```{r}
# Extract predictions for all emotions
emotion_predictions <- expand_grid(
  exp_condition = c("control", "anxiety", "hope")
) |>
  add_epred_draws(er1, re_formula = NA) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(.epred = .epred * 100)

# Calculate pairwise contrasts
emotion_contrasts <- emotion_predictions |>
  select(.category, exp_condition, .draw, .epred) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = exp_condition, values_from = .epred) |>
  mutate(
    anxiety_vs_control = anxiety - control,
    hope_vs_control = hope - control,
    anxiety_vs_hope = anxiety - hope
  )

emotion_contrast_summary <- emotion_contrasts |>
  group_by(.category) |>
  summarise(
    across(
      c(anxiety_vs_control, hope_vs_control, anxiety_vs_hope),
      list(
        lower = ~hdi(.x, .width = 0.95)[[1]],
        upper = ~hdi(.x, .width = 0.95)[[2]]
      ),
      .names = "{.col}_{.fn}"
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    anxiety_diff_control = sign(anxiety_vs_control_lower) == sign(anxiety_vs_control_upper),
    hope_diff_control = sign(hope_vs_control_lower) == sign(hope_vs_control_upper),
    anxiety_diff_hope = sign(anxiety_vs_hope_lower) == sign(anxiety_vs_hope_upper)
  )

# Generate compact letter display
emotion_cld <- emotion_contrast_summary |>
  mutate(
    control_label = case_when(
      !anxiety_diff_control & !hope_diff_control & anxiety_diff_hope ~ "ab",
      TRUE ~ "a"
    ),
    anxiety_label = case_when(
      !anxiety_diff_control & hope_diff_control & !anxiety_diff_hope ~ "ab",
      !anxiety_diff_control & !anxiety_diff_hope                     ~ "a",
      !anxiety_diff_control & anxiety_diff_hope                      ~ "a",
      anxiety_diff_control  & !anxiety_diff_hope                     ~ "b",
      anxiety_diff_control  & anxiety_diff_hope                      ~ "b"
    ),
    hope_label = case_when(
      !hope_diff_control & !anxiety_diff_hope & anxiety_diff_control  ~ "ab",
      !hope_diff_control & anxiety_diff_hope  & !anxiety_diff_control ~ "b",
      !hope_diff_control & !anxiety_diff_hope & !anxiety_diff_control ~ "a",
      !hope_diff_control & anxiety_diff_hope  & anxiety_diff_control  ~ "a",
      hope_diff_control  & !anxiety_diff_hope                         ~ "b",
      hope_diff_control  & anxiety_diff_hope  ~ if_else(anxiety_diff_control, "c", "b")
    )
  ) |>
  select(.category, control_label, anxiety_label, hope_label) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(control_label, anxiety_label, hope_label),
    names_to = "condition",
    values_to = "cld"
  ) |>
  mutate(exp_condition = str_remove(condition, "_label")) |>
  select(.category, exp_condition, cld)

# Combine plotting data
emotion_plot_data <- emotion_predictions |>
  left_join(emotion_cld, by = c(".category", "exp_condition"))

# Emotion colors for parts 2 and 3
emotion_colors <- c(
  "Anxious" = "#AA3377",
  "Angry" = "#EE6677",
  "Calm" = "#CCBB44",
  "Hopeful" = "#66CCEE",
  "Happy" = "#4477AA"
)

```

```{r}
  mutate(

      .category,
      levels = c("Anxious", "Angry", "Calm", "Hopeful", "Happy"),

    ),
```

## Emotion Differences in the Control Condition

Multivariate model of the five emotion ratings with residual correlations (`set_rescor(TRUE)`), as the ratings come from the same participants.

```{r}
#| output: false
er1_rc <- brm(
  data = df_mod,
  family = gaussian(),
  formula = bf(mvbind(Anxious, Angry, Hopeful, Happy, Calm) ~ exp_condition) +
    set_rescor(TRUE),
  prior = priors_er,
  sample_prior = "yes",
  init = "random",
  chains = chains,
  iter = iter,
  warmup = warmup,
  seed = bayes_seed,
  control = list(
    adapt_delta = adapt_delta,
    max_treedepth = max_treedepth
  )
)
```

```{r}
# Residual correlations between emotion ratings
tidy(er1_rc, parameters = "^rescor__", robust = TRUE,
     conf.method = "HPDinterval", rhat = TRUE, ess = TRUE) |>
  select(Term = term,
         Median = estimate,
         "95% HDI Lower" = conf.low,
         "95% HDI Upper" = conf.high,
         "R-hat" = rhat,
         ESS = ess) |>
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), \(x) round(x, 3))) |>
  tt()
```

```{r}
er1_rc_control_comps <- avg_predictions(
  er1_rc,
  newdata = datagrid(exp_condition = "control"),
  by = "group",
  hypothesis = ~ pairwise) |>
  as_tibble() |>
  select(Contrast = hypothesis,
         Median = estimate,
         "95% HDI Lower" = conf.low,
         "95% HDI Upper" = conf.high)

er1_rc_control_comps |> tt()
```

Paired t-tests as a frequentist check of the same contrasts.

```{r}
control_emotions_pairwise <- df_mod |>
  filter(exp_condition == "control") |>
  select(id, Anxious, Angry, Hopeful, Happy, Calm) |>
  pivot_longer(-id, names_to = "emotion", values_to = "rating") |>
  arrange(emotion, id) |>
  pairwise_t_test(
    rating ~ emotion,
    paired = TRUE,
    detailed = TRUE,
    p.adjust.method = "holm"
  )

control_emotions_pairwise |>
  select(`Group 1` = group1,
         `Group 2` = group2,
         Estimate = estimate,
         "95% CI Low" = conf.low,
         "95% CI High" = conf.high,
         p, p.adj, df) |>
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), \(x) round(x, 3))) |>
  tt()
```

## Heterogeneity in Emotional Effects

Moderation of the effects on the anxiety–hope dimension (ah models) and the five emotion ratings (er models) by age group, gender, living standard, age (continuous), and parental ideology.

### Setup

```{r}
emotions <- c("Anxious", "Angry", "Hopeful", "Happy", "Calm")

# Moderation figures: anxiety–hope in black, emotions in the colors of the main text figure
emotion_levels <- c("Anxious", "Angry", "Calm", "Hopeful", "Happy")
outcome_colors <- c("Anxiety–Hope" = "black", emotion_colors)
outcome_shapes <- c("Anxiety–Hope" = 15, setNames(rep(16, 5), emotion_levels))
outcome_linewidths <- c("Anxiety–Hope" = 1.6, setNames(rep(0.9, 5), emotion_levels))

# Tidy marginaleffects output into a table with consistent column names
me_tidy <- \(x) x |>
  as_tibble() |>
  select(any_of(c("group", "contrast", "hypothesis", "exp_condition",
                  "age_group", "gender", "living_standard")),
         estimate, conf.low, conf.high) |>
  rename(any_of(c(
    Emotion = "group",
    Contrast = "contrast",
    "Moderator Contrast" = "hypothesis",
    Condition = "exp_condition",
    "Age Group" = "age_group",
    Gender = "gender",
    "Living Standard" = "living_standard"
  ))) |>
  rename(Median = estimate,
         "95% HDI Lower" = conf.low,
         "95% HDI Upper" = conf.high)
```

Living standard: collapse difficult and very difficult given the small number of respondents in "very difficult" (<5%)

```{r}
df_mod <- df_mod |>
  mutate(
    living_standard_orig = living_standard,
    living_standard = fct_collapse(
      living_standard_orig,
      Comfortable = levels(living_standard_orig)[1],
      Coping = levels(living_standard_orig)[2],
      Difficult = levels(living_standard_orig)[3:4]
    ) |> fct_rev(),
    living_standard_num = 5 - as.integer(living_standard_orig),
    living_standard_z = as.numeric(scale(living_standard_num))
  )

df_mod |> count(living_standard_orig, living_standard, living_standard_num, living_standard_z)
```

Age: standardise

```{r}
age_mean <- mean(df_mod$age)
age_sd <- sd(df_mod$age)
to_age_z <- \(x) (x - age_mean) / age_sd

df_mod <- df_mod |>
  mutate(age_z = to_age_z(age))

c(mean = age_mean, sd = age_sd)
df_mod |> summarise(across(c(age, age_z), list(min = min, max = max)))
```

Parental ideology: standardise

```{r}
pi_mean <- mean(df_mod$parental_ideology, na.rm = TRUE)
pi_sd <- sd(df_mod$parental_ideology, na.rm = TRUE)
to_pi_z <- \(x) (x - pi_mean) / pi_sd

df_mod <- df_mod |>
  mutate(parental_ideology_z = to_pi_z(parental_ideology))

c(mean = pi_mean, sd = pi_sd)

df_mod |>
  summarise(n_missing = sum(is.na(parental_ideology)),
            prop_missing = mean(is.na(parental_ideology)),
            min = min(parental_ideology, na.rm = TRUE),
            max = max(parental_ideology, na.rm = TRUE))
```

### Age Group

#### Models

```{r}
#| output: false
ah2 <- brm(
  data = df_mod,
  family = gaussian(),
  formula = anxiety_hope_dim ~ exp_condition * age_group,
  prior = priors,
  sample_prior = "yes",
  init = "random",
  chains = chains,
  iter = iter,
  warmup = warmup,
  seed = bayes_seed,
  control = list(
    adapt_delta = adapt_delta,
    max_treedepth = max_treedepth),
  file = here(model_dir, "ah2.rds")
  )
```

```{r}
ah2_brms <- tidy(ah2, robust = TRUE, conf.method = "HPDinterval", rhat = TRUE, ess = TRUE) |>
  filter(effect == "fixed") |>
  mutate(term = case_when(
    term == "(Intercept)"                                ~ "Intercept",
    term == "exp_conditionhope"                         ~ "Hope (vs. Control)",
    term == "exp_conditionanxiety"                      ~ "Anxiety (vs. Control)",
    term == "age_group22M26years"                       ~ "Age Group 22-26 (vs. 16-21)",
    term == "exp_conditionhope:age_group22M26years"     ~ "Age Group x Hope",
    term == "exp_conditionanxiety:age_group22M26years"  ~ "Age Group x Anxiety",
    TRUE ~ term
  )) |>
  select(Term = term,
         Median = estimate,
         MAD = std.error,
         "95% HDI Lower" = conf.low,
         "95% HDI Upper" = conf.high,
         "R-hat" = rhat,
         ESS = ess)
```

```{r}
ah2_brms_table <- ah2_brms |>
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), \(x) round(x, 3))) |>
  tt()

ah2_brms_table
ah2_brms_table |>
  save_tt(here(table_dir, "ah2_brms_table.docx"), overwrite = TRUE)
```

```{r}
#| output: false
er2 <- brm(
  data = df_mod,
  family = gaussian(),
  formula = bf(mvbind(Anxious, Angry, Hopeful, Happy, Calm) ~ exp_condition * age_group) +
    set_rescor(FALSE),
  prior = priors_er,
  sample_prior = "yes",
  init = "random",
  chains = chains,
  iter = iter,
  warmup = warmup,
  seed = bayes_seed,
  control = list(
    adapt_delta = adapt_delta,
    max_treedepth = max_treedepth
  ),
  file = here(model_dir, "er2.rds")
)
```

```{r}
er2_brms_raw <- map(emotions, \(em) {
  tidy(er2, parameters = paste0("^b_", em), robust = TRUE,
       conf.method = "HPDinterval", rhat = TRUE, ess = TRUE) |>
    mutate(Outcome = em,
           term = str_remove(term, paste0("b_", em, "_")))
}) |>

er2_brms <- er2_brms_raw |>
  mutate(term = case_when(
    term == "(Intercept)"                                ~ "Intercept",
    term == "exp_conditionhope"                         ~ "Hope (vs. Control)",
    term == "exp_conditionanxiety"                      ~ "Anxiety (vs. Control)",
    term == "age_group22M26years"                       ~ "Age Group 22-26 (vs. 16-21)",
    term == "exp_conditionhope:age_group22M26years"     ~ "Age Group x Hope",
    term == "exp_conditionanxiety:age_group22M26years"  ~ "Age Group x Anxiety",
    TRUE ~ term
  )) |>
  select(Outcome, Term = term,
         Median = estimate,
         MAD = std.error,
         "95% HDI Lower" = conf.low,
         "95% HDI Upper" = conf.high,
         "R-hat" = rhat,
         ESS = ess)
```

```{r}
         MAD = std.error,

         "95% HDI Upper" = conf.high,
         "R-hat" = rhat,
```

#### 3. Anxiety–Hope and Emotion Ratings

Model predictions (median and 95% HDI) by condition and gender ("other" is included in the models but not shown); black squares show the anxiety–hope dimension.

```{r}
#| fig-width: 11
#| fig-height: 4.5
gender_preds <- bind_rows(
  predictions(ah3, newdata = datagrid(exp_condition = unique, gender = c("male", "female"))) |>
    as_tibble() |>
    mutate(outcome = "Anxiety–Hope"),
  predictions(er3, newdata = datagrid(exp_condition = unique, gender = c("male", "female"))) |>
    as_tibble() |>
    mutate(outcome = as.character(group))
) |>
  mutate(
    across(c(estimate, conf.low, conf.high), \(x) x * 100),
    outcome = factor(outcome, levels = names(outcome_colors)),
    exp_condition = factor(exp_condition, levels = c("control", "anxiety", "hope"),
                           labels = c("Control", "Anxiety", "Hope"))
  )

gender_fig <- gender_preds |>
  ggplot(aes(x = gender, y = estimate, ymin = conf.low, ymax = conf.high,
             color = outcome, shape = outcome)) +
  geom_pointrange(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), size = 0.5, linewidth = 1.1) +
  facet_grid(. ~ exp_condition, switch = "x") +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("male" = "Men", "female" = "Women")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = outcome_colors, name = NULL) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = outcome_shapes, name = NULL) +
  guides(color = guide_legend(nrow = 1), shape = guide_legend(nrow = 1)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Rating (0–100)") +
  theme_allround() +
  theme(
    # Strips below the x labels act as a nested condition axis
    strip.placement = "outside",
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    panel.spacing.x = unit(1.5, "lines"),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "grey90", linewidth = 0.2)
  )

gender_fig

ggsave(here(figure_dir, "moderation_gender.svg"), plot = gender_fig,
       width = 11, height = 4.5, web_fonts = svg_fonts)
```

```{r}
er3_mod_comps <- avg_comparisons(
```

### Parental Ideology

#### Models

```{r}
#| output: false
ah6 <- brm(
  data = df_mod,
  family = gaussian(),
  formula = anxiety_hope_dim ~ exp_condition * parental_ideology_z,
  prior = priors,
  sample_prior = "yes",
  init = "random",
  chains = chains,
  iter = iter,
  warmup = warmup,
  seed = bayes_seed,
  control = list(
    adapt_delta = adapt_delta,
    max_treedepth = max_treedepth)
  )
```

```{r}
ah6_brms <- tidy(ah6, robust = TRUE, conf.method = "HPDinterval", rhat = TRUE, ess = TRUE) |>
  filter(effect == "fixed") |>
  mutate(term = case_when(
    term == "(Intercept)"                              ~ "Intercept",
    term == "exp_conditionhope"                        ~ "Hope (vs. Control)",
    term == "exp_conditionanxiety"                     ~ "Anxiety (vs. Control)",
    term == "parental_ideology_z"                      ~ "Parental Ideology (z)",
    term == "exp_conditionhope:parental_ideology_z"    ~ "Parental Ideology x Hope",
    term == "exp_conditionanxiety:parental_ideology_z" ~ "Parental Ideology x Anxiety",
    TRUE ~ term
  )) |>
  select(Term = term,
         Median = estimate,
         MAD = std.error,
         "95% HDI Lower" = conf.low,
         "95% HDI Upper" = conf.high,
         "R-hat" = rhat,
         ESS = ess)
```

```{r}
ah6_brms_table <- ah6_brms |>
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), \(x) round(x, 3))) |>
  tt()

ah6_brms_table
ah6_brms_table |>
  save_tt(here(table_dir, "ah6_brms_table.docx"), overwrite = TRUE)
```

```{r}
#| output: false
er6 <- brm(
  data = df_mod,
  family = gaussian(),
  formula = bf(mvbind(Anxious, Angry, Hopeful, Happy, Calm) ~ exp_condition * parental_ideology_z) +
    set_rescor(FALSE),
  prior = priors_er,
  sample_prior = "yes",
  init = "random",
  chains = chains,
  iter = iter,
  warmup = warmup,
  seed = bayes_seed,
  control = list(
    adapt_delta = adapt_delta,
    max_treedepth = max_treedepth
  )
)
```

```{r}
er6_brms_raw <- map(emotions, \(em) {
  tidy(er6, parameters = paste0("^b_", em), robust = TRUE,
       conf.method = "HPDinterval", rhat = TRUE, ess = TRUE) |>
    mutate(Outcome = em,
           term = str_remove(term, paste0("b_", em, "_")))
}) |>
  list_rbind()

er6_brms <- er6_brms_raw |>
  mutate(term = case_when(
    term == "(Intercept)"                              ~ "Intercept",
    term == "exp_conditionhope"                        ~ "Hope (vs. Control)",
    term == "exp_conditionanxiety"                     ~ "Anxiety (vs. Control)",
    term == "parental_ideology_z"                      ~ "Parental Ideology (z)",
    term == "exp_conditionhope:parental_ideology_z"    ~ "Parental Ideology x Hope",
    term == "exp_conditionanxiety:parental_ideology_z" ~ "Parental Ideology x Anxiety",
    TRUE ~ term
  )) |>
  select(Outcome, Term = term,
         Median = estimate,
         MAD = std.error,
         "95% HDI Lower" = conf.low,
         "95% HDI Upper" = conf.high,
         "R-hat" = rhat,
         ESS = ess)
```

```{r}
er6_brms_table <- er6_brms |>
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), \(x) round(x, 3))) |>
  select(-Outcome) |>
  tt() |>
  group_tt(i = list(
    "Anxious" = 1,
    "Angry"   = 7,
    "Hopeful" = 13,
    "Happy"   = 19,
    "Calm"    = 25
  ))

er6_brms_table
er6_brms_table |>
  save_tt(here(table_dir, "er6_brms_table.docx"), overwrite = TRUE)
```

#### 1. Association across Conditions

```{r}
ah6_mod_slope <- avg_slopes(
  ah6,
  newdata = datagrid(exp_condition = unique),
  variables = "parental_ideology_z") |>
  as_tibble() |>
  select(Median = estimate,
         "95% HDI Lower" = conf.low,
         "95% HDI Upper" = conf.high) |>
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), \(x) x / pi_sd, .names = "{.col} (per scale point)"))

ah6_mod_slope |> tt()
```


Supporting: condition contrasts at parental ideology 0 (left), 5, and 10 (right)

```{r}
ah6_comps <- comparisons(
  ah6,
  variables = list(exp_condition = "pairwise"),
  newdata = datagrid(parental_ideology_z = to_pi_z(c(0, 5, 10)))) |>
  as_tibble() |>
  mutate(parental_ideology = round(parental_ideology_z * pi_sd + pi_mean)) |>
  select(Contrast = contrast,
         `Parental Ideology` = parental_ideology,

         "95% HDI Lower" = conf.low,
         "95% HDI Upper" = conf.high)

ah6_comps |> tt()
```

#### 3. Anxiety–Hope and Emotion Ratings

Model predictions (median and 95% HDI) by condition across parental ideology; black lines show the anxiety–hope dimension.

```{r}
#| fig-width: 11
#| fig-height: 4.5
pi_preds <- bind_rows(
  predictions(ah6, newdata = datagrid(exp_condition = unique, parental_ideology_z = to_pi_z(seq(0, 10, by = 0.5)))) |>
    as_tibble() |>
    mutate(outcome = "Anxiety–Hope"),
  predictions(er6, newdata = datagrid(exp_condition = unique, parental_ideology_z = to_pi_z(seq(0, 10, by = 0.5)))) |>
    as_tibble() |>
    mutate(outcome = as.character(group))
) |>
  mutate(
    across(c(estimate, conf.low, conf.high), \(x) x * 100),
    parental_ideology = parental_ideology_z * pi_sd + pi_mean,
    outcome = factor(outcome, levels = names(outcome_colors)),
    exp_condition = factor(exp_condition, levels = c("control", "anxiety", "hope"),
                           labels = c("Control", "Anxiety", "Hope"))
  )

pi_fig <- pi_preds |>
  ggplot(aes(x = parental_ideology, y = estimate, ymin = conf.low, ymax = conf.high,
             color = outcome, fill = outcome)) +
  geom_ribbon(alpha = 0.1, color = NA) +
  geom_line(aes(linewidth = outcome)) +
  facet_grid(. ~ exp_condition) +
  scale_color_manual(values = outcome_colors, name = NULL) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = outcome_colors, name = NULL) +
  scale_linewidth_manual(values = outcome_linewidths, name = NULL) +
  guides(color = guide_legend(nrow = 1), fill = guide_legend(nrow = 1),
         linewidth = guide_legend(nrow = 1)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 10, 2)) +
  labs(x = "Parental Ideology (0 = Left, 10 = Right)", y = "Rating (0–100)") +
  theme_allround() +
  theme(
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    panel.spacing.x = unit(1.5, "lines"),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "grey90", linewidth = 0.2)
  )

pi_fig

ggsave(here(figure_dir, "moderation_parental_ideology.svg"), plot = pi_fig,
       width = 11, height = 4.5, web_fonts = svg_fonts)
```

### Overview Figure

Treatment effects on the anxiety–hope dimension overall (ATE) and by age group, gender, and living standard.

```{r}
# ah1: Overall ATE
ah1.draws <- expand.grid(
  exp_condition = c("control", "anxiety", "hope")
) |>
  add_epred_draws(ah1, re_formula = NA) |>
  ungroup()

ah1.contrasts <- ah1.draws |>
  select(exp_condition, .draw, .epred) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = exp_condition, values_from = .epred) |>
  mutate(
    `Anxiety - Control` = anxiety - control,
    `Hope - Control` = hope - control,
    `Anxiety - Hope` = anxiety - hope
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(`Anxiety - Control`, `Hope - Control`, `Anxiety - Hope`),
    names_to = "contrast",
    values_to = "estimate"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    model = "ATE",
    subgroup = "ATE"
  )

# ah2: cATE by age group
ah2.draws <- expand.grid(
  exp_condition = c("control", "anxiety", "hope"),
  age_group = unique(df_mod$age_group)
) |>
  add_epred_draws(ah2, re_formula = NA) |>
  ungroup()

ah2.contrasts <- ah2.draws |>
  select(exp_condition, age_group, .draw, .epred) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = exp_condition, values_from = .epred) |>
  mutate(
    `Anxiety - Control` = anxiety - control,
    `Hope - Control` = hope - control,
    `Anxiety - Hope` = anxiety - hope
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(`Anxiety - Control`, `Hope - Control`, `Anxiety - Hope`),
    names_to = "contrast",
    values_to = "estimate"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    model = "Age",
    subgroup = as.character(age_group)
  ) |>
  select(-age_group)

# ah3: cATE by gender
ah3.draws <- expand.grid(
  exp_condition = c("control", "anxiety", "hope"),
  gender = unique(df_mod$gender)
) |>
  add_epred_draws(ah3, re_formula = NA) |>
  ungroup() |> 
  filter(gender != "other")

ah3.contrasts <- ah3.draws |>
  select(exp_condition, gender, .draw, .epred) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = exp_condition, values_from = .epred) |>
  mutate(
    `Anxiety - Control` = anxiety - control,
    `Hope - Control` = hope - control,
    `Anxiety - Hope` = anxiety - hope
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(`Anxiety - Control`, `Hope - Control`, `Anxiety - Hope`),
    names_to = "contrast",
    values_to = "estimate"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    model = "Gender",
    subgroup = as.character(gender)
  ) |>
  select(-gender)

# ah4: cATE by living standard
ah4.draws <- expand.grid(
  exp_condition = c("control", "anxiety", "hope"),
  living_standard = levels(df_mod$living_standard)
) |>
  add_epred_draws(ah4, re_formula = NA) |>
  ungroup()

ah4.contrasts <- ah4.draws |>
  select(exp_condition, living_standard, .draw, .epred) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = exp_condition, values_from = .epred) |>
  mutate(
    `Anxiety - Control` = anxiety - control,
    `Hope - Control` = hope - control,
    `Anxiety - Hope` = anxiety - hope
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(`Anxiety - Control`, `Hope - Control`, `Anxiety - Hope`),
    names_to = "contrast",
    values_to = "estimate"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    model = "Living Standard",
    subgroup = as.character(living_standard)
  ) |>
  select(-living_standard)

ah_plot_data <- bind_rows(ah1.contrasts, ah2.contrasts, ah3.contrasts, ah4.contrasts) |>
  mutate(
    estimate = estimate * 100,
    contrast = factor(contrast, levels = c("Anxiety - Hope", "Anxiety - Control", "Hope - Control")),
    model = factor(model, levels = c("ATE", "Age", "Gender", "Living Standard")),
    subgroup = case_when(
      subgroup == "male" ~ "Men",
      subgroup == "female" ~ "Women",
      subgroup == "16-21 years" ~ "16-21",
      subgroup == "22-26 years" ~ "22-26",
      TRUE ~ subgroup
    ),
    subgroup = factor(subgroup, levels = c("ATE", "22-26", "16-21", "Women", "Men",
                                           "Comfortable", "Coping", "Difficult"))
  )

# Compute whether HDI excludes zero for each group
ah_hdi_check <- ah_plot_data |>
  group_by(model, contrast, subgroup) |>
  median_hdi(estimate, .width = 0.95) |>
  mutate(excludes_zero = if_else(sign(.lower) == sign(.upper), "Excludes zero", "Includes zero")) |>
  select(model, contrast, subgroup, excludes_zero)
```

```{r}
#| fig-height: 7
#| fig-width: 8
ah_plot_data |>
  left_join(ah_hdi_check, by = c("model", "contrast", "subgroup")) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = estimate, y = subgroup, fill = excludes_zero)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray40", linewidth = 0.6) +
  stat_slabinterval(
    .width = c(.95),
    point_interval = "median_hdi",
    scale = 0.7,
    slab_alpha = 0.6,
    interval_alpha = 1,
    point_alpha = 1,
    normalize = "groups",
    point_size = 2.5,
    interval_size = 1.5) +
  facet_grid(model ~ contrast, scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("Excludes zero" = "#364B9A", "Includes zero" = "#4A7BB7"),
    name = "95% HDI"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(-10, 30, by = 10)) +
  labs(
    x = "Percentage Points",
    y = NULL,
    title = "Effects on Anxiety–Hope Dimension",
    subtitle = "Posterior Distributions with Median and 95% HDI"
  ) +
  theme_allround() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "grey90", linewidth = 0.2)
  )

ggsave(here(figure_dir, "anxiety_hope_ate_cate_posterior.svg"), height = 7, width = 8, web_fonts = svg_fonts)
```

### Raw Emotion Ratings by Subgroup

Raw mean (SD) emotion ratings (0–100) by condition overall and within each age group, gender, and level of living standard. The colour scale is centred on the scale midpoint (50).

```{r}
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 6.2
# Raw mean (SD) emotion ratings by condition, overall and within each subgroup
means_heatmap_data <- bind_rows(
  df_mod |> mutate(moderator = "Overall", level = "All"),
  df_mod |> mutate(moderator = "Age Group", level = as.character(age_group)),
  df_mod |> filter(gender != "other") |> mutate(moderator = "Gender", level = as.character(gender)),
  df_mod |> mutate(moderator = "Subjective Living Standard", level = as.character(living_standard))
) |>
  filter(!is.na(level)) |>
  select(moderator, level, exp_condition,
         Anxious = exp_check_anxious, Angry = exp_check_angry, Calm = exp_check_calm,
         Hopeful = exp_check_hopeful, Happy = exp_check_happy) |>
  pivot_longer(Anxious:Happy, names_to = "emotion", values_to = "rating") |>
  summarise(mean = mean(rating, na.rm = TRUE), sd = sd(rating, na.rm = TRUE), n = sum(!is.na(rating)),
            .by = c(moderator, level, exp_condition, emotion)) |>
  mutate(
    emotion = factor(emotion, levels = c("Anxious", "Angry", "Calm", "Hopeful", "Happy")),
    exp_condition = factor(exp_condition, levels = c("control", "anxiety", "hope"),
                           labels = c("Control", "Anxiety", "Hope")),
    level = factor(level,
                   levels = c("All", "16-21 years", "22-26 years", "male", "female", "Difficult", "Coping", "Comfortable"),
                   labels = c("All", "16–21", "22–26", "Men", "Women", "Difficult", "Coping", "Comfortable")),
    moderator = factor(moderator, levels = c("Overall", "Age Group", "Gender", "Subjective Living Standard")),
    label = paste0(round(mean), "\n(", round(sd), ")")
  )

means_heatmap_fig <- means_heatmap_data |>
  ggplot(aes(x = emotion, y = fct_rev(level), fill = mean)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_text(aes(label = label, color = abs(mean - 50) > 18), size = 3, lineheight = 0.9,
            family = "Public Sans Regular", show.legend = FALSE) +
  facet_grid(moderator ~ exp_condition, scales = "free_y", space = "free_y",
             labeller = labeller(moderator = label_wrap_gen(18))) +
  scale_fill_distiller(palette = "RdBu", direction = -1, limits = c(20, 80), oob = scales::squish,
                       breaks = seq(20, 80, 10), name = "Mean emotion rating (0–100)") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "white", `FALSE` = "grey15")) +
  guides(fill = guide_colorbar(title.position = "top", title.hjust = 0.5,
                               barwidth = unit(14, "lines"), barheight = unit(0.8, "lines"))) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_allround(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.title = element_text(size = rel(0.9)),
    axis.line = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1),
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 270, lineheight = 1),
    panel.spacing = unit(0.8, "lines")
  )

means_heatmap_fig

ggsave(here(figure_dir, "moderation_emotions_means_heatmap.svg"), plot = means_heatmap_fig,
       width = 10, height = 6.2, web_fonts = svg_fonts)
```
